knownLimitations: Permission/licence basis: Site operator permission reported by the project owner (verbal, not documented in writing); fetched from public recipe pages on 2026-10-24
Coverage of the full Global recipe list has not been established.
Output quantity is assumed to be 1 for every recipe: the source pages do not show it. Recipes are not human-verified, so all are marked unverified.
The source lists Elyos and Asmodian versions as separate recipes (512 recipe entries for about 394 distinct products); both are kept with their own source ids.
Success chance, COMBO odds and other source fields are not imported. Aion2.gg describes itself as an unofficial database in beta.
